title: Gang Kid and the pianist Thomas
summary: Wilson knows Gang Kid and recalls Thomas, a blues pianist at parties.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Back to these piano players, do you remember Gang Kid?
Gang Kid. He played around up there, up front. I don't know what I know him. Drive them down.

Yes I know him. Drive them down. Drive them down. And we had a fellow, he used to play around parties, and the deals around that. We used to call him, his name was Thomas. In other words he was a ballast music player, we had ballast music, but that's what the people wanted in my day. Oh yeah. They wanted those blues and you know.
Thomas played piano or some of the-
Oh yeah, he was a good piano player, you know, he was a good piano player.
